name: KeystoneJS
tagline: Node.js + GraphQL headless CMS. Schema-as-code, batteries included.
shortDescription: KeystoneJS is a Node.js headless CMS. Schema-as-code, auto-generated GraphQL/REST APIs, Admin UI, authentication, document fields. Build your CMS in code, not config files.
longDescription:
## What it is

KeystoneJS is a Node.js headless CMS. You define your schema in JavaScript, and Keystone auto-generates the GraphQL + REST APIs, Admin UI, and auth. Supports Postgres, MySQL, SQLite, and MongoDB.

## Why we recommend it

If you're a Node.js developer who wants a headless CMS that you can fully own (no vendor lock-in, no SaaS), KeystoneJS is the answer. The schema-as-code approach is a developer favorite.

## When to use it

- Headless CMS for a Node.js / React app
- Custom CMS you want to own
- When you want GraphQL + REST from day one
- Startups that want a CMS without monthly fees
installCommand: npm init keystone-app my-app && cd my-app && npm start
installInstructions:
**Quick start:**
```
npm init keystone-app my-app
cd my-app
npm install
npm start
```

Admin UI at `http://localhost:3000`, GraphQL playground at `/admin/api`.
pricingDetails: Free. MIT licensed. Self-host on Node.js.
